title: Pocket Items
description: Makes held items smaller and cleaner.
body:
**Pocket Items** makes held items smaller in first person, giving you a cleaner and less obstructed view while keeping the vanilla Minecraft style.

This is perfect for mining, building, exploring, fighting or using larger items like shields, bows, crossbows, tools and blocks without having them cover so much of your screen.

## Features

- Reduces held item size in first person
- Makes tools, weapons, bows, shields and blocks less intrusive
- Gives you a clearer view while playing
- Works great for mining, building, combat and exploration
- Lightweight and simple
- Vanilla friendly

## Why use it?

Normally, some held items can take up a lot of screen space, especially shields, bows, crossbows, tools, and large block items. **Pocket Items** fixes that by making items more compact while still keeping them recognizable and close to the vanilla look.

## Compatibility

This pack changes item model display settings, so it should work with most other resource packs that only change item textures. Place **Pocket Items** above other packs if another pack also changes item models or held item size.
